name: Nala Ankar Bridge
facts: Nala Ankar Bridge, erected under General Musharraf’s administration and Punjab’s Chief Minister Ch. Parvez Elahi, showcases mid‑2000s Pakistani infrastructure ambition to boost local economy.
Public protests over fatal accidents on the Nala Ankar turn spurred the bridge’s construction, turning a dangerous bend into a safer, smoother passage for commuters.
Spanning the Nala Ankar stream, the bridge lies roughly 7–10 kilometres from Talagang on the Mianwali Road, linking the villages of Saghar and Dhok Phulari.
